item.title: Orange County community voices outrage over school district proposal to support ICE
item.description: The Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District considered a resolution affirming the district's support for federal immigration officers, among other law enforcement.

item.title: New California law protects outreach workers offering support to those experiencing homelessness
item.description: This new law eases the worries of outreach workers who fear they will be criminalized for offering their services.

item.title: SoCal to see a few dry days before more rain. Here's when the next storm will move in
item.description: Enjoy a few mild and sunny days before more storms move into Southern California early next week.

item.title: El Monte police video shows moments before federal agents shatter activist's car window
item.description: El Monte police video captures the moments leading up to federal agents shattering an activist's car window while she sat crying in the driver's seat.

item.title: Instagram chief says he does not believe people can get clinically addicted to social media
item.description: Adam Mosseri, the head of Meta's Instagram, testified Wednesday during a landmark social media trial that he disagrees with the idea that people can be clinically addicted to social media platforms.

item.title: Goats tasked with clearing brush from rain before wildfire season in Verdugo Park
item.description: To prevent wildfires, 200 female goats are grazing the dry brush on the hillsides of Verdugo Park, expected to clear up to 20 acres by this weekend.

item.title: Hollywood Hills mansion break-in prompts search for armed intruders
item.description: Los Angeles police are searching for suspected thieves after a break-in at a sprawling mansion in the Hollywood Hills.

item.title: Bud Cort, best known for role in 'Harold and Maude,' dies at 77
item.description: Actor Bud Cort, best known for his role in the 1971 film "Harold and Maude," has died. He was 77.

item.title: City officials hoping to reduce fires in the Sepulveda Basin by cutting down trees
item.description: Leaders in the Sepulveda Basin are working hard to clear out trees and remove debris. They believe fires in recent years are due to homeless encampments in the basin.

item.title: Casey Wasserman will continue to lead LA28 after review of Epstein-related allegations, board says
item.description: Casey Wasserman will continue serving as chair of LA28 after the board reviewed his involvement in the recently released Jeffrey Epstein files.
